svg.title: C07-M05-F1: VPN extends a trusted boundary
svg.desc: A diagram of a remote device tunnelling to a corporate gateway with the note that post-connection access must still be least-privilege.
svg.text: C07-M05-F1 VPN extends a trusted boundary
remote device == encrypted tunnel == corporate gateway
confidentiality + integrity + endpoint authentication across untrusted net
AFTER connecting: still enforce least privilege (segmentation / ZTNA),
Figure C07-M05-F1. A VPN protects transit; access after connecting must still be
